segments.text: What if Naruto joined the Akatsuki? Oh, fantastic.
segments.label: BAD CAREER MOVE

segments.text: Our boy saw matching villain cloaks and thought, career opportunity.
segments.label: THE CLOAK IS A RED FLAG

segments.text: Motherflicker, they are hunting the fox inside you.
segments.label: YOU ARE THE TARGET

segments.text: That is not a job interview. You are the lunch.
segments.label: NOT AN INTERVIEW

segments.text: In this made-up timeline, he bargains for his friends' safety.
segments.label: A MADE-UP DEAL

segments.text: Fine. But the cloak comes with suspiciously aggressive management.
segments.label: SUSPICIOUS MANAGEMENT

segments.text: Pain calls it peace. The village gets a demolition notice.
segments.label: PEACE WITH A DEMOLITION NOTICE

segments.text: Naruto says, can we maybe try a conversation first?
segments.label: CAN WE TALK FIRST

segments.text: And Obito? Mask on. Accountability off. Absolutely excellent hiring department.
segments.label: ACCOUNTABILITY OFF

segments.text: At first, missions go well. Our boy finally feels respected.
segments.label: FINALLY SOME RESPECT

segments.text: Then comes the assignment: betray the Hidden Leaf.
segments.label: THE REAL ASSIGNMENT

segments.text: Brother. That is your home. Read the stupid contract.
segments.label: READ THE CONTRACT

segments.text: He refuses. Suddenly the new team questions his loyalty.
segments.label: HE REFUSES

segments.text: Sakura is left picking through rubble. Some protection plan.
segments.label: SOME PROTECTION PLAN

segments.text: Even his old friends cannot tell whose side he is on.
segments.label: OLD FRIENDS, NEW DOUBTS

segments.text: Congratulations, genius. Two teams, zero trust, absolutely no dental insurance.
segments.label: TWO TEAMS. ZERO TRUST.

segments.text: So he stops chasing approval and chooses his people.
segments.label: CHOOSE YOUR PEOPLE

segments.text: The Akatsuki wanted a weapon. They got an argument.
segments.label: WEAPON OR ARGUMENT

segments.text: Could he actually change them? Maybe. This is Naruto.
segments.label: COULD HE CHANGE THEM

segments.text: But friendship speeches cannot fix every murderous group project.
segments.label: THE GROUP PROJECT FROM HELL

segments.text: Would you trust his plan, or confiscate the cloak immediately?
segments.label: KEEP OR CONFISCATE THE CLOAK
